deviations.deviation: Mutations ran in `mutrepo`, a copy of `u1repo`, not in `u1repo`.
deviations.reason: The copyBack files must stay exactly as verified; the spec §3 also says "never in place". Each mutant is still applied in place in the copy, restored, and sha-compared.

deviations.deviation: T2 is four `it.each` cases (400/409 x `unlearnedDraft`/`needsRelearnDraft`), with the "decided after the refusal" check made by a harness flag (`afterRefusal`) instead of an index into `observed`.
deviations.reason: `observed` records `request:start`, and the page's own mount reads of the test start at the same moment as the refused read, so an index comparison cannot tell them apart. The flag is set when the refusal is answered (300 ms), as the spec's flip harness describes.

deviations.deviation: T3 counts the readiness reads with a `pointerKept` flag taken when each request arrives, and asserts `[true, false]` for the two reads after the Refresh press.
deviations.reason: This proves "exactly one readiness check before the pointer drops, then the gate's one re-read" without racing the poll; total is 2, none more in 300 ms (spec §8 item 8).

deviations.deviation: T4 answers the draft's own readiness (`UNLEARNED`) before the refusal, and 503 after it; the other cases answer `LEARNING` before.
deviations.reason: The spec asserts `data-run-mode` is `learn` in T4. With `LEARNING` before the refusal the gate would read `busy`. Everything else is as specified: 3 attempts (one `getTest`, two `apiClient` retries), none more in 1500 ms.

deviations.deviation: T6's refused session read is delayed 300 ms.
deviations.reason: Without the delay the page's own mount reads were counted as the readiness check on the frozen bytes (first red run: `checks` was 2). The test now also asserts `checks === 1`, so it is red on the frozen bytes (the check does not exist) and not vacuous.

deviations.deviation: T2/T6 and T1 were re-run on the frozen bytes after two test-harness fixes (T2 title order, T6 delay, T1 pointer snapshot). The earlier full-file red logs are kept.
deviations.reason: The first versions had harness slips, found by reading their failures; the reruns give the red reason for the final tests.

deviations.deviation: `secretDeclaration.test.ts` is red as a whole (10 of 10) on the frozen bytes.
deviations.reason: The return type changed from an array to `{ok, rows} | {ok:false}`, so every test fails on the old function. The behaviour-bearing reds are the three refused cases and the parity table.

deviations.deviation: A few assertions beyond the spec text: `authoredLiteralHint.test.ts` pins N as the 1-based draft position under a reordered draft; `secretDeclaration.test.ts` adds "refusal returns no rows" and "names are trimmed"; `guided.test.tsx` `guidedCopy` adds sentence checks for `sessionUnreadable`, `secretNameTaken`, `learningElsewhere`, expiry and singular forms; `replayFailure.test.tsx` also checks the absent cases; H2 records `pending` as well as `unreadable`.
deviations.reason: They pin the specified wording and rules in the same files; no source behaviour beyond the spec depends on them. H2 needs `pending` because `NOT_READY` clears within a few milliseconds and cannot be awaited.

deviations.deviation: `UX-22` (record only) has no code. `GuidedClarification.tsx` and `GuidedRunStatus.tsx` are unchanged.
